description: Business process map in Universal Process Notation (UPN)
Customer journey map; activities are touchpoints grouped by stage
Entities with key fields and their relationships
Which automations fire in what order (the chain level) and the logic inside each one (one level per automation)
Capability tree as a grid of columns: text-box headings over capability cards; optional business drivers above and rating colours
Systems and the data flowing between them: a hub in the centre with sources left, destinations right, engagement above and ingestion below; groups as cards with a drill-down
